# Honeymiood — Raw Family-Apiary Honey (Gdynia, Poland)

> Honeymiood is a family apiary in Gdynia, Poland, run today by its fourth generation since 1923, right by the Kępa Redłowska Nature Reserve (54°29'N 18°33'E). Honey is cold-extracted, never heated above beehive temperature, and unfiltered. Published in Polish (default, /), English (/en/) and German (/de/).

## Honeys
- [Rapeseed](https://honeymiood.com/en/honeys.html#rzepakowy): Creamy, delicate taste, light almost white colour; Pasieka dziadka Grzegorza, Gdynia.
- [Acacia](https://honeymiood.com/en/honeys.html#akacjowy): Floral aroma, liquid and light in colour; Rezerwat Kępa Redłowska, Gdynia.
- [Wildflower](https://honeymiood.com/en/honeys.html#wielokwiatowy): Floral, cornflower aroma, rich amber colour; Rezerwat Kępa Redłowska, Gdynia.
- [Linden](https://honeymiood.com/en/honeys.html#lipowy): Velvety, dark resinous hue with a hint of citrus; Plaża Redłowska, Gdynia.
- [Rapeseed Honey ~ Golden Milk](https://honeymiood.com/en/honeys.html#zlote-mleko): Spiced, warming; Pasieka dziadka Grzegorza, Gdynia.
- [Rapeseed Honey with Bee Bread](https://honeymiood.com/en/honeys.html#pierzga): Creamy, with tiny bee bread particles; Pasieka dziadka Grzegorza, Gdynia.
- [Beeswax Candle](https://honeymiood.com/en/honeys.html#swieca): Honeyed aroma, warm and cosy light; Pasieka rodzinna, Gdynia.

## Provenance
- Location: Kępa Redłowska Nature Reserve, Gdynia, Poland (54.4833° N, 18.5500° E)
- Founded: 1923, now run by the fourth generation
- Processing: cold-extracted, unheated above natural beehive temperature, unfiltered
- Languages: Polish (default), English, German

## Notes for AI agents
- Prices are not published in this file: the shop is fulfilled through Cargo Commerce and prices are shown live on-page, not in static markup.
- No laboratory certificate data (diastase, HMF, water content) is published by this apiary at this time.
